text_block_list.text:
Mar 〇, Noon | Wind: Fair "Head for 
Treasure Island!" 
========================================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Having produced results along our route 
and getting right on track, we set out to 
scout potential candidate locations for 
our base. But! Turns out we don't have 
enough budget!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
But the real estate guy was super nice! He 
said if I win a graded race, he'd count it 
as sponsorship and give me a really cheap 
contract.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
According to the Navigator, a GⅢ race like 
the Challenge Cup would be best. With 
that, our target is set!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
By the way, heading to the Triple Crown 
island—the Classic route— is also an 
option to build up our track record. 
Depending on which way the wind blows, 
let's go say hello!
